Senior Economist · World Bank, DEC Enterprise Analysis Unit

::: {.lede}

I am a Senior Economist in the World Bank's [Enterprise Analysis unit](https://www.enterprisesurveys.org) , where
I have worked since 2010. My work focuses on data collection on private enterprise, especially informal businesses. 
My research interests include informality, labor supply, institutional economics, corruption, and political economy. I also co-edit the World Bank's Policy Indicators Briefs series, which can be found [here](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/unit-dec/policy-indicators-group/policy-indicators-briefs). 

This page is my personal website, featuring [research](https://davidcfrancis.github.io/research.html) and [code](https://davidcfrancis.github.io/code.html). 

:::
